newsitem.title: MALTA: Maltese government plans first budget.
newsitem.headline: Maltese government plans first budget.

text.p: Malta's new Labour government will present its first budget on January 13 when it will announce a new taxation system to replace Value Added Tax, Prime Minister Alfred Sant said on Wednesday.
He told a working lunch with the Chamber of Commerce that his government, elected last October, inherited public finances that were "in a mess" with no coordination on spending.
He said his government would emphasise a stabilisation plan for public finance over the next two years "without introducing measures that could dampen or cramp the operations of the private sector".
The budget would also clamp down on tax evasion, ensure price stability and introduce measures to make Maltese exports and tourism more competitive.
The government has already announced it would not increase rates of direct taxes but would replace VAT with indirect taxation, customs and excise.
